scenario: 一个直播评论系统写入量约 5k WPS；调优良好的单机 Postgres 简单写入参考值是 20k+ WPS。

options: 5k WPS 远低于单机上限，先别急着分库分表
只要用关系型数据库就必须提前分片
写吞吐超过 1k 就该换 NoSQL
写吞吐低就可以不建索引
why: 20k+ WPS 是单机 Postgres 简单写入的参考上限，5k 远在其内；此时分库分片是过度设计，应先看事务复杂度和索引写放大。
why_en: A well-tuned single Postgres handles 20k+ simple writes per second, so 5k WPS does not justify sharding yet.
options_en: 5k WPS is well under the single-node ceiling, so don't shard yet.
Any relational database must be pre-sharded.
Switch to NoSQL once writes pass 1k per second.
Skip indexes because write volume is low.

scenario: 系统写入约 5k WPS，候选人立刻想加消息队列来「缓冲这么高的写吞吐」。
q: 这个判断的问题在于？

错，单机 20k+ WPS 能扛，加队列过度设计

why_en: At 5k writes per second a message queue is over-engineering, since a single Postgres handles 20k+; simpler tuning suffices.
whenOtherWins: 当需要可靠投递（下游故障不丢）、事件溯源、写尖峰超过单机能力（>20k WPS），或要解耦生产者/消费者时，队列才真正值得。
options_en: Yes, 5k WPS already needs a queue.
No, a single node handles 20k+ WPS; adding a queue is over-engineering.
No, you should shard the database directly.
No, you should switch to NoSQL instead.

why_en: Indexed lookups are already 1-5ms cached or 5-30ms from disk, so adding a cache just for simple row reads is often unnecessary.

Disk reads are basically as fast as cache hits.
Indexed simple lookups are already fast enough without a dedicated cache.
Only a cache can achieve millisecond-level reads.

why_en: Ten million businesses at about one kilobyte each is only ten gigabytes, roughly a hundred with reviews, so sharding is unnecessary.
options_en: That is way too much data, so it must be sharded immediately.
Business data like this must go on a distributed database.
It works out to about 100GB, which a single node easily handles.
The volume is too complex to estimate.

scenario: 面试被问到 Design Yelp，候选人还没算过数据量就想先讲分片方案。
q: 补全 Yelp 的容量估算：
text: 1000 万商家 × 每个约 1KB ≈ {{10GB}}；再 ×10 计入评论 ≈ {{100GB}}，这个量级单机{{无需分片}}。
why: 把「条数 × 每条大小」算成总量级，是判断要不要分片的第一步；100GB 完全在单机能力内。

scenario: 面试者一上来就说要给主键查询加缓存层，理由是数据库延迟太高。
q: 这个判断哪里错了？
options: SSD 查询要几百毫秒，必须加缓存
所有查询都该无脑加缓存
数据库根本做不了主键查询
索引主键查询已是毫秒级，无需单独加缓存
why: 带索引的简单行查询是亚毫秒到几毫秒，已经很快；为它单独加缓存层是多余复杂度。复杂 join/聚合查询仍值得缓存。
why_en: Indexed row lookups are sub-millisecond to a few milliseconds, so adding a cache just for them is unnecessary infrastructure.
whenOtherWins: 如果是跨多表 join、聚合的昂贵查询，那仍然值得缓存——快的只是「带索引的简单行查询」。
options_en: SSD lookups take hundreds of milliseconds, so you must cache them.
You should blindly cache every query.
Databases cannot serve primary-key lookups at all.
Indexed primary-key lookups are already millisecond-fast, so no extra cache is needed.

options_en: A single instance's 100k-200k+ ops/s reference covers it, no sharding needed yet.
Cache throughput is usually only a few hundred ops/s, so shard immediately.
Higher ops/s means you must switch to disk storage.
Cache throughput has nothing to do with instance size.

Dataset nears 1TB or throughput sustains 100k+ ops/s.

why: 水平扩容触发：CPU 持续 >70-80%、延迟超 SLA、内存 >70-80%，或网络带宽逼近上限。容器 30-60s 即可起新实例。
why_en: Scale horizontally when CPU stays above 70-80%, latency exceeds SLA, memory trends high, or network nears instance limits.
whenOtherWins: 如果只是偶发尖峰、平时利用率低，自动扩缩容比长期超额预置更划算。
tradeoff: 硬性资源/延迟阈值 vs 表面运行时长或用户数信号
options_en: The system has more than 10 users.
CPU stays above 70-80%, or latency exceeds SLA.
Memory usage is only at 10%.
The service has been running for over a day.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务等级协议，对延迟、可用性等指标的承诺目标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An SLA is the promised target for a metric such as latency or availability.

scenario: 一个电商大促前，团队在设计自动扩容策略：流量升高就临时加机器，而不是长期超额预置。
q: 容器启动速度这个量级最支持哪条设计判断？
options: 容器启动要几十分钟，只能靠长期超额预置
启动速度和自动扩容策略无关
容器 30-60 秒即可起新实例，激进自动扩容是可行替代方案
容器启动越快，说明可以不做健康检查
why: 容器化应用 30-60 秒即可起新实例，这个速度让「激进自动扩容」成为超额预置之外的可行替代方案。
why_en: Containerized apps start in about 30 to 60 seconds, making aggressive auto-scaling practical instead of over-provisioning.
options_en: Containers take tens of minutes to start, so only heavy over-provisioning works.
Startup speed is unrelated to auto-scaling strategy.
Containers start in 30-60 seconds, making aggressive auto-scaling viable.
Faster startup means health checks can be skipped.

termDefinitions.meaning: 根据负载自动增减实例数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Auto-scaling automatically adds or removes instances based on load.

scenario: 一个多可用区部署的服务把主库放在一个 AZ，只读副本放在同区另一个 AZ，报表服务放在另一个大洲。
q: 这组网络延迟量级最支持哪条设计判断？
options: 跨大洲和同 AZ 延迟基本没区别
只要同区，延迟就一定 <1ms
网络延迟和可用区划分无关
同区跨 AZ 延迟仍在 1-2ms，是可靠的默认架构
why: 同 AZ 内 <1ms，同区跨 AZ 1-2ms，跨区域 50-150ms；这组数字支撑了同区多 AZ 部署这种可靠架构。
why_en: Latency is under a millisecond within an AZ, 1-2ms across AZs in a region, and 50-150ms cross-region, which supports multi-AZ deployment as a reliable default.
options_en: Cross-continent and same-AZ latency are basically the same.
As long as it's the same region, latency is always under 1ms.
Network latency has nothing to do with AZ layout.
Cross-AZ latency within a region stays at 1-2ms, a reliable default architecture.

termDefinitions.meaning: 云区域内相互隔离的独立机房。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An availability zone is an isolated data-center location within a cloud region.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从主库同步数据、只处理读请求的副本实例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A read replica copies data from the primary and serves read-only traffic.

scenario: 一个内存计算引擎打算把 3TB 数据集整个放进单台机器内存里做实时聚合。
q: 这组内存量级最支持哪条设计判断？
options: 内存优化型实例可到 4TB 甚至 24TB，3TB 单机装得下
单机内存普遍封顶 64GB，必须先拆成分布式
内存实例最多 128GB，装不下 3TB
内存上限和实例类型无关
why: 通用实例已达 512GiB，内存优化型可到 4TB、24TB；3TB 单机可行，很多曾需分布式的应用现在单机就能跑。
why_en: Memory-optimized instances reach 4TB or even 24TB of RAM, so a 3TB dataset fits on a single machine without going distributed.
options_en: Memory-optimized instances reach 4TB or even 24TB, so 3TB fits on one machine.
Single-machine memory tops out around 64GB, so it must be distributed.
Memory instances cap at 128GB, too small for 3TB.
Memory ceiling has nothing to do with instance type.

scenario: 一个日志归档系统单节点数据量已经涨到 40TB 本地磁盘，团队在争论要不要马上上分布式文件系统。
q: 这组存储量级最支持哪条设计判断？
options: 本地磁盘普遍封顶 1TB，早该上分布式了
本地 SSD/HDD 上限很高，40TB 单机能装下
只能用网络存储，本地磁盘不可用
存储容量和实例类型无关
why: 本地 SSD 可达 60TB（i3en），HDD 达 336TB（D3en）；40TB 单机可行，存储早已不是主要约束。
why_en: Modern instances offer up to 60TB of local SSD or 336TB of HDD, so 40TB fits on a single machine without going distributed.
options_en: Local disks typically cap at 1TB, so it's overdue for distribution.
Local SSD and HDD ceilings are high, so 40TB fits one machine.
Only network storage works; local disks are not usable.
Storage capacity has nothing to do with instance type.

termDefinitions.meaning: 固态硬盘，比机械硬盘快得多的存储介质。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An SSD is a solid-state drive, a storage medium much faster than spinning disks.

termDefinitions.meaning: 机械硬盘，容量大但比 SSD 慢。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An HDD is a spinning hard disk drive, higher capacity but slower than SSD.

scenario: 评估要不要在现有系统里引入消息队列。
q: 消息队列在什么情况下才「真正值得」引入？（多选）
options: 需要可靠投递：下游故障时消息不丢
事件溯源 / 数据集成等模式
写尖峰超过单机数据库能力（如 >20k WPS）或要解耦生产者与消费者
稳定 5k WPS 的简单插入
why: 队列值得用在：可靠投递、事件溯源、超过单机能力的写尖峰、生产/消费解耦。稳定 5k WPS 的简单写单机就够，不该为它加队列。
why_en: Queues are justified by guaranteed delivery, event sourcing, write spikes beyond a single database, or decoupling, not by a steady 5k WPS.
tradeoff: 真正值得引入队列的硬需求 vs 尚在单机能力内的写量
options_en: Guaranteed delivery: messages must not be lost if downstream fails.
Event-sourcing or data-integration patterns.
Write spikes beyond a single database's capacity, or decoupling producer from consumer.
A steady 5k WPS of simple inserts.

termDefinitions.meaning: Writes per second，数据库每秒成功处理的写入次数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: WPS is the number of write operations a database completes each second.

scenario: 写吞吐看起来偏高，团队正讨论要不要立刻加消息队列。
q: 在为「较高写入」加消息队列之前，应先考虑哪些更简单的手段？（多选）
options: 批量写入（batch writes）
优化 schema 与索引，减少写放大
有效使用连接池
立刻改造成全异步微服务架构
why: 加队列前先试：批量写、优化 schema/索引、连接池、对非关键写用异步提交。这些比「引入队列或重构成异步架构」简单得多。
why_en: Before adding a queue, try batch writes, schema and index tuning, and connection pooling.
options_en: Batch writes.
Tune schema and indexes to reduce write amplification.
Use connection pooling effectively.
Immediately rebuild everything as fully async microservices.

termDefinitions.meaning: 复用一批数据库连接，避免每次请求都新建连接。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A connection pool reuses a set of database connections instead of opening a new one per request.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次逻辑写导致的实际底层写入量被放大，常见于索引过多。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Write amplification means one logical write triggers more physical writes underneath, often from excess indexes.

q: 把「决定要不要分片」的正确思考顺序排好：
steps: 先给出数据模型和规模（条数、每条大小、TPS）
做算术：估出总数据量与读写吞吐的量级
对照单机能力（约 50 TiB、10k+ WPS、50k 读 TPS）
只有超出单机能力时才分片，否则保持单机 + 副本
why: 反过来做（先讲怎么分片）是最常见的错误。正确顺序：给规模 → 做算术 → 对照单机上限 → 真超了才分片。
why_en: Decide sharding by stating the scale, doing the math, comparing to single-node limits, and only then sharding if exceeded.
diagram:
flowchart LR
    Inputs["records x size x QPS"] --> Math["order math"]
    Math --> Limit["compare limits"]
    Limit --> Decision["simple vs shard"]
tradeoff: 先算术验证单机上限 vs 直接假设需要分片

termDefinitions.meaning: 二进制计量的存储单位，1 TiB 约等于 1.1 TB。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A TiB is a binary storage unit, about 1.1 times a decimal terabyte.

termDefinitions.meaning: Writes per second，数据库每秒成功处理的写入次数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: WPS is the number of write operations a database completes each second.

termDefinitions.meaning: Transactions per second，数据库每秒处理的事务数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TPS is the number of transactions a database completes each second.

scenario: 一个团队只用一台数据库主实例，没有分片，正在讨论这是不是单点故障。
q: 「单实例数据库」是否就等于单点故障（SPOF）？
options: 是，单实例必然是单点故障
只有分片才能避免单点
不是，主库+只读副本能做高可用
副本反而会降低可用性
why: 「不分片」不等于「单点」：主库 + 只读副本（如 Aurora 多 AZ 故障转移）就能做高可用；HA 复制与 scale 分片是两回事。
why_en: A single instance is not a single point of failure, since you still run a primary with read replicas for availability, separate from sharding for scale.
options_en: Yes, a single instance is inherently a single point of failure.
Only sharding can avoid a single point of failure.
No, a primary with read replicas provides high availability.
Replicas actually reduce availability.

termDefinitions.meaning: 单点故障：某个组件一旦失效，整个系统就不可用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A single point of failure is a component whose failure takes down the whole system.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从主库同步数据、只处理读请求的副本实例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A read replica copies data from the primary and serves read-only traffic.

termDefinitions.meaning: 主节点失效后自动切换到备用节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Failover automatically switches traffic to a standby node when the primary fails.

scenario: 面试官问起系统设计时该怎么考虑云成本。
q: 在系统设计面试里，关于「成本」的正确态度是？
options: 要背熟 AWS 定价表，精确到美元
完全不用考虑成本
成本是面试的核心评分项
只看数量级，但明显浪费会被挑出来
why: 面试很少纠结精确定价，量级判断就够；但明显浪费（100 台干 1 台的活）会被面试官挑出来。
why_en: Interviews care about order-of-magnitude cost sense, not memorized pricing, though obviously wasteful designs still raise flags.
options_en: Memorize AWS pricing tables down to the dollar.
Cost never needs to be considered at all.
Cost is the core scoring criterion in interviews.
Only order-of-magnitude matters, but obvious waste gets called out.

scenario: 面试要给一个缓存服务做容量估算，需要几个记得住的锚点数字。
q: 补全缓存的关键数字（速记）：
text: 缓存：延迟约 {{1ms}}、吞吐 {{100k}}+ ops/s、内存可达约 {{1TB}}；扩容看 ops/s 或网络带宽，通常不是内存。
why: 缓存三件套：~1ms、100k+ ops/s、~1TB。记住量级，面试里做容量估算就不会被带偏。
why_en: Cache rules of thumb are about one millisecond latency, 100k+ ops per second, and up to a terabyte of memory.

termDefinitions.meaning: Operations per second，缓存每秒处理的读写操作次数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Ops per second counts the read and write operations a cache handles each second.

scenario: 面试要给一个关系型数据库做容量估算，需要几个记得住的锚点数字。
q: 补全数据库的关键数字（速记）：
text: 数据库：读吞吐最高约 {{50k}} TPS、写约 {{10-20k}} TPS、缓存命中读延迟 <{{5ms}}、单实例存储 {{64 TiB}}+。
why: 数据库速记：读 ~50k / 写 10-20k TPS、缓存读 <5ms、存储 64TiB+。这组数字是判断「要不要分片」的基准线。
why_en: Database rules of thumb are up to 50k read TPS, 10-20k write TPS, sub-5ms cached reads, and 64 TiB+ storage.

termDefinitions.meaning: Transactions per second，数据库每秒处理的事务数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TPS is the number of transactions a database completes each second.

termDefinitions.meaning: 二进制计量的存储单位，1 TiB 约等于 1.1 TB。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A TiB is a binary storage unit, about 1.1 times a decimal terabyte.

scenario: 一个后台任务系统给数据库直接开了 3k 个短连接，没用连接池；候选人在判断这样是否安全。
q: 这组并发连接量级最支持哪条设计判断？
options: 单实例能扛 5k-20k 连接，3k 安全但该上连接池
数据库最多只能扛约 100 个连接，3k 早就超了
并发连接数没有上限，不用管理
连接数和数据库实例类型无关
why: 单实例数据库约支持 5k-20k 并发连接，3k 在安全范围内；连接数常成为运维约束，这也是用连接池的原因。
why_en: A single database instance supports roughly 5,000 to 20,000 concurrent connections, so 3k is safe but still worth pooling.
options_en: A single instance handles 5k-20k connections; 3k is safe but should use pooling.
A database can only handle about 100 connections; 3k is already way over.
Concurrent connections have no ceiling, so no need to manage them.
Connection capacity has nothing to do with instance type.

termDefinitions.meaning: 复用一批数据库连接，避免每次请求都新建连接。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A connection pool reuses a set of database connections instead of opening a new one per request.

scenario: 一个订单事件系统平均消息体约 5KB，要求保留 3 个月历史用于回放和审计。
q: 这组消息大小与保留量级最支持哪条设计判断？
options: 消息队列只能处理 <1KB 的小消息
队列能高效处理 1KB-10MB 消息，保留数月完全可行
队列重启后数据就会丢，存不了 3 个月
消息大小和保留时长互相无关，随便设
why: 队列可高效处理 1KB-10MB 消息，单 broker 存储达 50TB，保留数周至数月；5KB、3 个月都在能力内。
why_en: Modern queues efficiently handle 1KB-10MB messages and retain data for weeks to months, so a 5KB message kept for three months fits easily.
options_en: Message queues can only handle messages under 1KB.
Queues efficiently handle 1KB-10MB messages, so months of retention is fine.
Data is lost on restart, so three months of retention is impossible.
Message size and retention length are unrelated, so set them arbitrarily.

termDefinitions.meaning: Kafka 集群里负责存储和转发消息的单个节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A broker is a single node in a Kafka cluster that stores and forwards messages.

scenario: 面试里有人纠结「用 2015/2020 年的硬件约束」做扩展估算，动不动就说数据库要在 100GB 拆分。
q: 更专业的做法是？
options: 沿用 2015 年的旧数字，宁可保守
完全不做任何容量估算
用现代硬件量级估算，避免过度设计
只相信教科书上的数字
why: 用过时硬件数字是「有书本知识但缺实战」的典型信号，会导致过度设计；应以当下量级（单机 TB 级）做决策。
why_en: Use modern hardware numbers, since quoting outdated constraints signals book knowledge without real experience and leads to over-engineering.
whenOtherWins: 这些是「调优良好系统的典型值」，是容量规划的起点而非硬上限——具体随工作负载、硬件、配置而变。
tradeoff: 现代硬件量级估算 vs 过时教科书约束
options_en: Stick with 2015-era numbers to stay conservative.
Skip capacity estimation entirely.
Estimate using modern hardware scale to avoid over-engineering.
Trust only the numbers printed in textbooks.

q: 把「面对看似很高的写吞吐，是否加队列」的判断顺序排好：
steps: 先量化实际写吞吐与写模式（简单插入还是复杂事务）
对照单机能力：简单写单机 Postgres 约 20k+ WPS
若在能力内，先做批量写/索引优化/连接池等简单手段
只有真正超出单机能力或需要可靠投递/解耦时，才引入队列
why: 顺序：量化写模式 → 对照 20k+ WPS 单机上限 → 先上简单优化 → 真超了或有可靠投递/解耦需求才加队列。避免为 5k WPS 过度设计。
why_en: Quantify the write pattern, compare to the 20k+ WPS single-node limit, try simple tuning first, and only add a queue if truly exceeded.
diagram:
flowchart LR
    Measure["Measure writes"] --> Compare["Compare 20k+ WPS"]
    Compare --> Simple["Optimize first"]
    Simple --> Queue["Queue only if needed"]
tradeoff: 先算术验证单机上限 vs 直接假设需要队列

termDefinitions.meaning: Writes per second，数据库每秒成功处理的写入次数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: WPS is the number of write operations a database completes each second.
